items.section: 4.6 Photosynthesis and respiration — the six sharing with the six
items.sentence: Carbon does not land as waste; it cycles between fixing and giving back, conserving, turning on.
items.text: A field samples isotope incorporation from 5 seconds to 60 minutes and follows respiratory isotope changes through 20 hours of darkness, measuring the uptake, release and store contributions of carbon atoms with their timing; each reading is a population reading across many carbon atoms, and is-not a continuous tracking of one carbon atom or an observing of an atom's wear.
items.from: **Natural Biology, ingestion and exhausting · Timing of exchange:** isotope inco

items.text: A field measures ATP in yeast cells a preparation washes into water at 30 minutes and at 19 hours, and growth recovering after long starvation; a pause in external nourishment, a self's internal resource use and a cycle of carbon atoms closing indefinitely are three readings, each distinct from the others.
items.from: **Natural Biology, continuing living · External supply and internal participatio

items.text: A preparation peels, washes and boils onion walls and sets a load and an enzyme treatment on them, and atomic force microscopy images microfibril rearrangement in five discrete stages, the preparation part of the observing; a microfibril, chains of many atoms with carbon atoms in them, is-not a carbon atom, and this five-stage imaging is-not a continuous record of living growth or of a carbon atom's wear.

items.section: 3.3 A left form is the emanation form of one right spiral
items.sentence: A cucumber tendril, once its tip grips, coils as two helices of opposite hand a perversion joins, net twist nothing, equal and opposite sides coupling with an empty centre (Darwin 1865; Gerbode and colleagues, Science 2012).
items.text: Tendrils a preparation constrains and ribbons a preparation extracts from them supply coils of opposite hand, a perversion joining them, and an over-winding depending on the preparation; their correspondence to waist 24, span 36 or opening 96 awaits a field's measure.
items.from: **Natural Biology, tendril coiling · The measured waist:** constrained tendrils

items.text: An atomic carbon chain is one row of carbon atoms and is-not a carbon atom, and ordinary B-form DNA is a double helix of many atoms about 2 nm across and is-not a carbon atom; this width comparison is-not a placing of a separate pure carbon chain inside DNA, and is-not a universal hard diameter for an atom.
items.from: **Natural Biology, DNA and carbon chains · Width and length:** an atomic carbon
